outcome: Long-term endocrine morbidity (including thyroid disease, insulin and non-insulin dependent diabetes mellitus, hypoglycemia, childhood obesity, parathyroid hormone disease, adrenal disease, and sex hormone disease)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 9312 small for gestational age (SGA) infants born between 1991 and 2014, alive at discharge, comparing those born to mothers with and without gestational diabetes mellitus.
finding: Small for gestational age (SGA) infants born to mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) did not show an increased risk for long-term endocrine morbidity compared to SGA infants born to non-diabetic mothers.
